summary: Calisa Acquisition Corp (a SPAC) filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Subscription Agreement with an accredited investor for a $1M PIPE investment (100k shares at $10.00/share) concurrent with its pending business combination with Goodvision AI Inc. The subscription closes substantially concurrently with the merger, subject to customary conditions. The shares are issued under Section 4(a)(2)/Reg D exemption. The filing updates the March 6, 2026 Business Combination Agreement. Risk-arb: watch for shareholder approval and regulatory clearance; no break fee or premium disclosed. This is a classic SPAC de-SPAC PIPE, not a routine event.
